# SleepNeedAccumulator

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computational concept where sleep pressure accumulates during wakefulness and decays during sleep, modeled as an integrator with saturation in neural circuits. Serves as a template for implementing leaky integrators or fatigue counters in neuromorphic systems to manage resource exhaustion and recovery cycles.
